newsitem.title: UK: Two stocks in demand on UK gilt repo market.
newsitem.headline: Two stocks in demand on UK gilt repo market.

text.p: The UK gilt repo market had an uneventful but fairly tight day, with the main interest focussed on the 7.0 percent gilts due 2002 and the 6.0 percent due 1999.
* 6.0s of 1999 quoted at around 5-1/2 to 5.0 percent
* 7.0s of 2002 around 5-1/2 to 5-1/4 for two weeks out to one month.
* "Very few bonds have had any value, people were throwing any bonds out just to get their cash in at half-way reasonable levels," one trader said.
* Overnight GC touched a high of around 6-3/4 percent.
* Overnight cash was quoted in late dealings at 6-1/8 6.0 percent.
* The Bank of England provided assistance totalling around 721 million stg after forecasting a shortage of 700 million.
